# Scientific thinking. Software engineering. Data and AI.

This portfolio brings together selected work and areas of practice across applied mathematics, environmental modelling, software engineering, data science, and machine learning.

It highlights the problems addressed, the technical choices made, the evidence used to assess results, and the limits of each project. Project-specific repositories and public deliverables are linked when available.
